sections.heading: 2026-2027 Academic Calendar
sections.text:
For additional key dates and deadlines, including course registration, withdrawals, and applying for graduation, see the Office of the Registrar's Academic Calendar .

Notice: These dates are subject to change.

sections.heading: Fall 2026
sections.text:
| Date | Event |
| --- | --- |
| September 2, 2026 | Fall semester classes begin |
| September 7, 2026 | Labor Day - No classes scheduled |
| October 12, 2026 | Fall Break - No classes scheduled |
| October 14, 2026 | Legislative Day - Classes meet according to a Monday schedule |
| November 26-27, 2026 | Thanksgiving Recess - No classes scheduled |
| December 14, 2026 | Fall semester classes end |
| December 16-22, 2026 | Final exam period |
